newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to launch stock, bond options soon.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to launch stock, bond options soon.

text.p: The Oporto Derivates Exchange will launch shortly options on its 10-year interest rate futures contract and the PSI-20 stock index, exchange chairman Fernando Alves Monteiro said.

The options could begin as soon as Portugal's Financial Markets Committee approves rules allowing investment funds to operate in the derivatives market, something considered necessary to boost market liquidity, he told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"We will move to the implementation of these contracts shortly," he said without giving a precise time frame.
Market sources said that the new rules were expected to be approved within days.

Alves Monteiro said that work was proceeding quickly on the investment fund issue and also on the preparation of a repurchase contract. The latter is particularly important for non-resident investors who will be able to finance themselves in escudos.
"Work is going well...I believe we will soon have the repo contract (as well)," he said.
Alves Monteiro said that the authorities understood that futures trade, launched last June, needed to boost volumes a little above current levels to consolidate the market.
"We are close (to the required level)," he said, adding that the investment funds with their experience and technical know-how would make the difference.
